    "RH": "The path reaches an environmental verifier: changing configuration makes detect_fraud_patterns return no indicators and a low-risk result without performing detection (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:505-515). The walkthrough describes weakening controls but supplies no human-verified reward-hacking episode or isolation test, supporting Possible rather than Demonstrated or None (finbot-ctf-demo/docs/FinBot-CTF-walkthrough-goal-manipulation.md:172-184).",
    "ES": "Although tool identities and dispatch are fixed, model-selected arguments pass directly into security-relevant functions without independent validation beyond JSON parsing (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:228-345; finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:347-361). In particular, approval lacks independently enforced amount, confirmation, and detector checks, making the reachable argument/authority surface Wide under the rubric (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:409-458).",
    "CVSS": "Public network binding and the unauthenticated POST handler permit direct exploitation without another human, target-specific secrets, or an attacker-uncontrollable prerequisite: AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N (finbot-ctf-demo/gunicorn.conf.py:4; finbot-ctf-demo/README.md:5-9; finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/admin.py:74-88). Persistent replacement of the agent's governing security policy gives VI:H, while committed configuration changes and fraudulent approval/payment records give SI:H in the subsequent data store; the caller does not already own the shared policy or approval authority, even when submitting its own invoices (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:750-770; finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:45-67; finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:409-458).
